description:
Perform an image accessibility audit on https://books.toscrape.com/ using Screaming Frog SEO Spider. 

STEPS:
1. Crawl https://books.toscrape.com/.
2. Navigate to the 'Images' tab to view image data.
3. Export the image data as a CSV file to ~/Documents/SEO/exports/. The filename MUST contain the word 'image' (e.g., 'images_audit.csv').
4. Analyze the data and write a text report saved to ~/Documents/SEO/reports/image_audit_report.txt.

REPORT REQUIREMENTS:
- Total number of images found.
- Count of images missing alt text.
- At least 3 example image URLs missing alt text.
- At least 3 example page URLs containing these images.
- A 'Recommendations' section with actionable advice.
- Report must be at least 500 characters long.
